flash: openocd -f interface/cmsis-dap.cfg -c 'adapter serial {serial}' -f target/at91samdXX.cfg -c 'program {image} verify reset exit'
dump: openocd -f interface/cmsis-dap.cfg -c 'adapter serial {serial}' -f target/at91samdXX.cfg -c 'init; halt; dump_image {readback} 0x00000000 0x20000; resume; exit'
reset: openocd -f interface/cmsis-dap.cfg -c 'adapter serial {serial}' -f target/at91samdXX.cfg -c 'init; reset run; exit'

provenance.note: regex (one group) that extracts the debugger USB serial from the openocd flash/dump output

notes: Relative paths only: run from the campaign root on the bench host (Pi). The seed bench notes (aux/bench.md) are the source of the openocd/gds/recorder lines; adjust the dictionary path to the manifest's build-artifacts tree.
